data.spec: Latest user explicitly says don't spend time duplicating backend; reuse Leo pushed feat/pydantic-agent-backend ee26a911 and user will act on his board connection. STOP separate apps/server/office_api/apps/api ports. Canonical Python runtime is Leo's apps/agent/office/api.py (FastAPI+PydanticAI): POST /api/input {board_id,text?|audio_b64?,person?}; POST /api/sensor {board_id,kind,value}; GET /api/state {tasks,orders,tickets,commands}; POST /api/tasks/:id/decide {approve:boolean}; /api/boards, /api/events (task.updated/state.changed/board.say etc), legacy /api/device-events and /api/devices/:board/command. Procurement builds reusable Python planning/severity/discovery integration against these entry points; no firmware or connection changes, no blanket branch checkout/merge over frontend work.
